definitions.full: H4658. mappeleth מַמֶּ֫לֶת noun feminine carcass, ruin, overthrow ; — 1 carcass , of lion, ׳מ construct Judg 14:8 . 2 elsewhere suffix a. a ruin , מַמַּלְתּוֺ Ezek 31:13 (kg. under figure of tree). b. overthrow, id.
